title: Peter and Cornelius
summary: The good news of Jesus is for every nation and people group. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.

read_it.prompt: Read Acts 10:1-48 and look for how this passage teaches: The good news of Jesus is for every nation and people group.

tell_it: God sent Peter to Cornelius, a Gentile. Peter learned that God welcomes people from every nation who turn to Him.
understand_it: The good news of Jesus is for every nation and people group. This lesson keeps the main point simple: God is faithful, His Word is true, and His people can respond with faith and obedience.
age_5_7_explanation: Peter and Cornelius reminds us that God is good and we can trust Him. Good News matters.
age_8_11_explanation: Peter and Cornelius shows that following God is not only knowing the story. It means learning this truth: The good news of Jesus is for every nation and people group.
teen_explanation: Peter and Cornelius gives older students room to think about faith under pressure. The passage teaches that the good news of Jesus is for every nation and people group. It also asks how belief becomes action.
key_truths: The good news of Jesus is for every nation and people group.
God is faithful and His people can trust Him.
life_application: A kid can practice this when good news is needed: at school, with siblings, during disappointment, or when choosing between an easy wrong thing and a harder right thing.

quiz_questions.question: Who did Peter visit?
quiz_questions.explanation: The passage points us back to this answer: Cornelius. It helps kids remember the main event and the truth it teaches.

quiz_questions.question: This lesson teaches that the good news of Jesus is for every nation and people group.
quiz_questions.explanation: That is the plain lesson focus for this passage, stated in kid-friendly language.

memory_verse.prompt: Remember Acts 10:34 as a short anchor for this lesson.

discussion_questions: What happened in Peter and Cornelius?
What does this passage teach us about God or following Him?
Where could this lesson help you at home, school, church, or with friends?

activity.title: Every Nation Table
activity.instructions: Draw or act out the lesson scene, then name the one clear truth: The good news of Jesus is for every nation and people group.

prayer_prompt: Lord, help me learn from Peter and Cornelius. Teach me to trust You, listen to Your Word, and live this truth this week.
